changelog:
- Initial release of math-proof: automated mathematical proof generation and review with A/B agent loop.
- Supports step-by-step agent proof generation, review, and iterative revision until accepted or retry limit reached.
- User chooses review feedback mode (Hint-only, With history, Full disclosure) and can provide reference materials.
- Fully honors user-specified constraints (method, tools, output format) in every prompt.
- Provides ongoing round-by-round status; halts after a configurable number of attempts if proof is not accepted.
summary: Automated step-by-step proof generation and review for user-submitted theorems with iterative refinement until acceptance or retry limit reached.
